description: This file defines the core 'editor' class and related constants for CKEditor, including methods for creating and replacing editor instances within DOM elements.

classes.name: CKEDITOR.editor
classes.description: Represents an editor instance with methods for initialization, event handling, and DOM element replacement.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new editor instance with configuration, linked DOM element, mode, and initial data.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.replace
methods.description: Replaces a textarea or DOM element with a CKEditor instance, hiding the original element.

methods.name: CKEDITOR.editor.appendTo
methods.description: Creates a new editor instance inside a specified DOM element.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the editor instance, adding it to a pending list for further setup.

methods.name: fire
methods.description: Triggers an event on the editor instance, passing the editor as a parameter.

methods.name: fireOnce
methods.description: Triggers a one-time event on the editor instance, passing the editor as a parameter.
